text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday was so much fun~!
I held on as best as I could, but ended up losing anyway...
Please challenge me again sometime, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Both of you were remarkably adept at strategy.
Thank you for such an enjoyable time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Still ain't enough to give me that real thrill, though.
If I'm gonna play, I want a gamble that burns hotter—something that leaves my throat bone-dry.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Do you mean to say it left you unsatisfied?
If so, you have my apologies.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
For future reference, could you tell me a little more
about the kind of contest you seek?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's gotta be a gamble with your life on the line.
The kind of showdown where if you lose, you're done, no future left—
that's the absolute best—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
What?! N-Not your life, please!
Could it be that, even until now...
you've been using your very life as a bargaining chip?!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama...
You must not wager your life so lightly on a game.
I cannot turn a blind eye to you exposing yourself to such danger.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a second, Prince.
It ain't done lightly.
It only means somethin' because it's heavy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It mustn't be too heavy either.
Listen, Nakayama. Social standing has no place here.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I... do not wish to lose a precious friend.
Even if staking your life... is your chosen way of living.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Please don't do something so dangerous...
If anything were to happen to you, Nakayama-san, I... I wouldn't know what to do...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: S-Sorry... Wait, why the hell am I apologizing?! Good grief... Don't go overwhelming me with your damn aura.
